newsitem.title: UK: Dorrell outstanding Health Secretary - UK's Major.
newsitem.headline: Dorrell outstanding Health Secretary - UK's Major.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major on Tuesday rallied round his Health Secretary Stephen Dorrell, calling his performance in his post "outstanding".

Dorrell stirred controversy at the weekend by ruling out British membership of a single European currency in 1999 in a clear breach of a cabinet agreement to take a "wait and see" stance on the issue. Major said in a radio interview earlier that Dorrell had made a mistake.
But at Prime Minister's question time, Major told Labour leader Tony Blair: "I think he (Dorrell) has been an outstanding Secretary of State for Health."
Blair had asked whether Major felt Dorrell should be trying to tackle the crisis in the National Health Service rather than fomenting a crisis in the Conservative Party.
